evidence: Carries the Tests label and resolves intermittent timeouts across multiple functional test suites by setting framework relay options and preserving test args.
rationale: Fixes flaky CI failures and drastically cuts execution time across eight functional tests. By setting `noban_tx_relay = True` and preserving whitelist arguments across restarts, it resolves Poisson relay timeouts tracked in issue #19732 and reduces test runtimes by up to 90%.
